notes.title: Music Workout Mode Added
notes.content: A new mode, 'Music Workout', has been added. There are 3 in game tracks to choose from and you can also generate workouts from your own music located in the folder you have set.

notes.title: Graphical Update
notes.content: The environment graphics have been updated, as well as the glove models and heavy bag physics.

notes.title: Coach Mode Added
notes.content:
A coach mode has now been added. In this mode you will be doing the pads with a boxing coach instead of the machine. You will receive points for every correctly completed combination and lose points for every one you get wrong.

If you are having trouble with any of the combinations then don't worry you will be asked to keep trying. The more you practice, the better you will become!

notes.title: Punch Bag Mode Added
notes.content: A punch bag mode has been added. In this mode you can take as long as you want, as there is no score. When a number is called out, throw a combination with that many punches.

notes.title: New Game Mode Added
notes.content: A new 'Punch Dodge Mode' has been added. This mode features short, faster paced combinations combined with a swinging arm, you have to avoid.
